notes:
POC focused on Dedicated capacity + SLA negotiation. Heavy emphasis on throughput guarantees and deterministic p95 latency. Short bullets from calls:
- 2026-02-14 call w/ CTO (Samir Patel) + infra lead (Elena R.) — wants predictable token throughput for risk scoring pipeline. Quote: 'We can tolerate some tail but need consistent p95 for requests tied to live trading decisions.'
- Top priority: reserved GPU planning (able to reserve equivalent of 4-8 A100-class GPUs initially, want plan to scale to 16 over next 12 months).
- Current infra: hybrid cloud with strict VPC peering rules, KMS in-house; cannot allow public egress for payloads. Will require private control plane or VPC-enabled Dedicated.
- Model preferences: 13B-70B class acceptable; client prefers quantized variants for cost but will validate quality regression. Suggest Redwood Provide: 13B q4f16 + 70B 8-bit for fallbacks.
- Use-case details: reranking for real-time credit decisions (avg prompt ~120 tokens, response ~60 tokens), throughput target 250-500 reqs/sec sustained during peak. Latency target p95 <= 200ms for 1-2 second generation window in critical path.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; wants eval for unit cost per 1M tokens; tradeoff: pay more for guaranteed reserved pool vs. cheaper burstable capacity.
- Security: SOC2 + SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logs and KMS symmetric key support. Data residency: US-only for now.
- Callouts: will run two parallel benchmarks: load tests (short-duration ramp tests) and 72-hour soak test at ~70% of expected sustained load. Both must run from their VPC-connected test agents.
- Internal stakeholders: Samir Patel (CTO), Elena R. (Head infra), R&D manager: Marco Diaz. Procurement lead: Jenna Cole.
poc_plan: Phase 0: Pre-POC - network & security checklist signed, DPA draft in legal review
Phase 1: Baseline run - single-node performance with model variants, measure token/s, p50/p95/p99 latencies
Phase 2: Load tests - synthetic traffic: 10k requests over 10 mins ramp to 500 RPS sustained for 20 mins, KV/prefix caching enabled/disabled runs
Phase 3: Soak test - 72h at 70% expected sustained load (~350 RPS) to validate stability, memory leaks, GC, OOMs
Phase 4: Failover and routing - simulate instance loss and validate automatic fallback to compatible model variant and region
Phase 5: Cost & ops handoff - provide per-token breakdown, autoscaling policy recommendations, reserved GPU sizing
poc_success_criteria: Throughput: sustained 350 RPS with average output length 60 tokens and p95 latency <= 200ms for primary model
Availability: 99.9% over 72h soak with graceful degradation to fallback model under instance loss
Quality: response quality delta vs. non-quantized baseline <= 2% measured by business eval set (reranking accuracy)
Cost: projected unit cost within 20% of target provided by procurement (target $/1M tokens specified in deck)
Operational: VPC peering stable, KMS integration validated, audit logs present and readable by their SIEM
poc_metrics_to_collect: cost per 1M tokens breakdown (model, infra, cache savings)
